string-array.name: loading_hints
string-array.item: First run downloads Steam. This may take a few minutes.
By default, leaving the app pauses Steam; it picks up where it left off when you come back.
Your controller appears as an Xbox 360 pad. Otherwise, use the on-screen controls.

string-array.name: loading_hints_desktop
string-array.item: First run sets up the desktop. This may take a few minutes.
By default, leaving the app pauses the session; it picks up where it left off when you come back.
Touch works as a touchpad: drag to move the pointer, tap to click.
Your controller appears as an Xbox 360 pad. Otherwise, use the on-screen controls.

resources.string: Shows while a Steam or desktop session is open
Session paused - tap Resume when ready

Choose Windows games with one subfolder per game. Steam checks ownership while signed in. Confirmed games use their Steam library entries after restarting Steam; other games stay as non-Steam shortcuts. Steam may verify or download files for imported games.
Adds a Steam library and scans Windows game folders here and in steamapps/common. After the ownership check and a Steam restart, owned games use Steam entries; other games use non-Steam shortcuts.
Forget removes non-Steam shortcuts next session. Manage Steam installations in Steam. Files stay on disk.
Applies on the next game launch.
Variables for Proton games, shared or per game.
Applies the next time a game starts.
Steam app ID or non-Steam compatibility ID
Left out of the game’s environment
Every change in this profile is removed. Defaults and shared values apply again.
Defaults give way to the same variable in a game’s Steam launch options. Values changed here take precedence over them.
Could not load or apply the settings. Check available storage and try again.
Use a valid variable name and a value without NUL characters (up to 8192 characters).
The standard Linux Proton runtime does not use this variable; it may require a custom component.
Mesa shader caching. false keeps it on, so shaders are not compiled again on every launch.
Turnip driver switches. sysmem renders straight to memory instead of in tiles, which avoids GPU hangs in some D3D12 games at some cost in speed.
D3D12 feature-level override. 12_2 reports DirectX 12 Ultimate capabilities; unsupported features can fail. Unset for automatic detection.
D3D12 shader-model override. 6_6 is the highest Turnip supports; a higher model advertises features the GPU lacks. Unset for automatic detection.
VKD3D options for D3D12. nodxr disables ray tracing; use only for a game that needs it.
Maximum Mesa shader-cache size, such as 1G. Larger caches use more storage.
Set to 1 for a Proton log, saved with the session’s logs. Logging can reduce performance and use storage.
Set to 1 to use OpenGL-based WineD3D instead of DXVK for D3D9–11 compatibility testing.
Set to 0 to disable Proton’s gamepad-navigation helper for this game.
DXVK overlay for D3D9–11. fps displays frame rate; unset hides it.
DXVK settings separated by semicolons. Recent builds use dxvk.maxFrameRate for frame limiting; prefer the session frame limiter for ordinary play.
D3D12 frame-rate limit. 0 disables the limit.
Mesa OpenGL threading. true can help CPU-limited OpenGL games; test per game.
Zink descriptor mode for OpenGL games. lazy can help where descriptor buffers are slow.
Set to 1 for games to treat the device as a Steam Deck.
Adreno feature overrides separated by colons. An unknown feature stops the game at start.
Hides OpenGL extensions newer than this year, for older games that fail on long extension lists.
OpenGL version reported to games, such as 4.6.
PulseAudio latency in milliseconds. A higher value can stop crackling.
Set to 1 to give 32-bit games up to 4 GB of address space.
Wine DLL overrides, such as dinput8=n,b.
Balanced TSO with reduced x87 precision.
Performance settings with main TSO enabled.
Disables self-modifying-code checks. JIT games and DRM may break.
Extreme settings with main TSO enabled.
Performance with TSC and metadata hints. Try before Extreme.
Performance with full code checks and the hypervisor bit hidden.
